description: PROP-AUTH-020 claims to test 'process exits non-zero when any required env var is missing' (REQ-AUTH-011) but the two test cases only call validateFrontendBaseUrl('') and assert it returns { ok: false }. The test descriptions say 'missing DISCORD_CLIENT_ID causes non-zero exit' and 'missing DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET causes non-zero exit' but neither test verifies actual process startup, env var checking for DISCORD_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/REDIRECT_URI/DATABASE_URL, or non-zero exit behavior. The validateFrontendBaseUrl function only validates FRONTEND_BASE_URL format — it has no knowledge of other env vars.
